system.description: The character moves from one dimension to another.
system.effect: The character instantly moves from their current dimension to another dimension within the same universe. For instance: from Earth to Asgard, Limbo or Kun-Lun. When they move to the other dimension, they can arrive in any place they've been to before. Otherwise, they arrive at the most common entrance to that dimension.

outcomes.label: Move the character to a previously visited place in another dimension of the same universe. Otherwise, use that dimension's most common entrance. Scene selection and token placement remain Narrator-controlled.
